params.body:
The pipeline diagram (`PipelineFlow.jsx`) drew three things that are not there.

- **A "Skills + Prompts" box** with dashed arrows into process and suggest. It counted `data.skills`, which the pipeline has not sent since Sanity, so it always showed 0; the table behind it was dropped on 2026-09-29. The prompts are code (`classify-prompt.mjs`, the Gentells Standard), and the taxonomy box already stands for that.
- **A "reader notes" arrow** from publish back to suggest. Readers' feedback is stored by the site in its own database, and nothing carries it to the pipeline; the pipeline's own `reader_feedback` table held one row and had no reader.
- **"topics × 7 gens × 13 regions"** under the taxonomy. Since the Gentells Standard it is 3 generations and 6 lifestages: the box now says "topics × 3 generations × 6 lifestages × 13 regions".

The "your edits improve the classifier" arc stays: editor corrections do reach classify (gentells-pipeline#237 removes the self-made ones that were crowding them out).

Lint at the ceiling (24), build ok, Playwright 24 of 24.
params.title: The pipeline diagram draws what is there
